numerical_failure.observed_behavior: The inner loop of the NNLS solver checks constraint violation with `s[P].min() <= tol` (a positive tolerance) instead of `s[P].min() <= 0`, so iterations do not converge for well-posed problems; in the MKL/AVX512 issue the test raises RuntimeError: Maximum number of iterations reached.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The constraint violation check in the inner loop should be `s[P].min() <= 0` per the referenced paper, so that well-posed problems converge.
